text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: 2143650000 - ALERT: tokenizer-service high CPU (node flaps) -> multiple pods OOMKilled in prod-us-east-1. Detected tokenization pipeline spike causing preproc threads to spin. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.sarah
sarah: hitting this now, getting repeated OOMs on tokenizer v1.13-hotpath. Pod logs show CPU pinned then kernel OOM.
- pods: tokenizer-xxxxx-1, tokenizer-xxxxx-2, tokenizer-xxxxx-3 all in CrashLoopBackOff
- node: gke-prod-01 (flapping)
- requests queueing upstream (envoy)

jia: joining. saw a cascade: heavy prompt fanout from a few customer corp keys -> burst of 40k small prompts in ~30s. Looks like prefix cache thrash + regex parse hotloop.

mike: pasting kernel OOM log snippet from pod stdout:
```
[2026-03-15T20:04:17Z] Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (tokenizer) total-vm:3456784kB, anon-rss:3123456kB, file-rss:0kB
[2026-03-15T20:04:17Z] oom_reaper: reaped process 12345 (tokenizer), now anon-rss:0kB
```

ravi: also seeing CUDA error lines intermittently on the GPU nodes (not all pods use GPU but some shared infra):
```
E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:xx] failed to allocate 256MB (error: out of memory)
E runtime: CUDA memory exhaustion on node gke-prod-gpu-03
```

emily: customer impact: several large embedding customers in EU reporting 502s and retries. Router metrics show 8% 5xx for /v1/embeddings in last 5m, 99th latency spiked to 8s.

incident-bot: auto-run playbook: scale_down_concurrency -> suggested: reduce tokenizer replicas and set max_concurrency=1 for the hot path.

sarah: immediate mitigation steps I'm doing now:
- cordon node gke-prod-01 to stop scheduling -> `kubectl cordon gke-prod-01`
- remove one problematic GPU node from pool (if flapping)
- temporarily throttle per-key qps via edge rate limiter for high-traffic keys
- restart tokenizer pods one-at-time with env REDWOOD_TOKENIZER_THREADS=2

jia: I applied an envoy rate-limit config for the flagged API keys (temporary 50r/s cap) and created a routing rule to send heavy tokenizer requests to dedicated-pool region (less loaded).

mike: pushing a micro-change to tokenizer image that disables the aggressive regex pass and falls back to simpler parse (image: tokenizer:v1.13-hotpatch-1). Deploying as canary to 1 pod: `kubectl set image deploy/tokenizer tokenizer=redwood/tokenizer:v1.13-hotpatch-1 --record`

deploy-bot: deployment/tokenizer image updated: tokenizer -> redwood/tokenizer:v1.13-hotpatch-1 (canary: 1/3 ready)

ravi: I also bumped systemd oom_score_adj on the tokenizer process to -1000 to deprioritize killing helper processes, but kernel OOM may still target the largest RSS. Trying to reduce memory footprint first.

emily: customer comms: notifying impacted customers in EU about degraded embeddings latency, advising retry/backoff. No data loss, only errors/delays.

sarah: after canary rollout, canary pod stayed up for 3m under same incoming load, memory usage lowered ~40%. I’m scaling canary to 3 pods, draining oldest pods.

jia: started cordon->drain on gke-prod-01 done, evicted remaining pods. Node removed from LB rotation. No new pods scheduled there.

mike: rolled the hotpatch to 60% of tokenizer pool. Observed OOM events drop sharply. Tokenizer CPU usage back to normal baseline. 5xx rate falling: now 2% on /v1/embeddings.

incident-bot: Incident update (2143650120): Mitigation in progress. Severity remains P1 until stable for 30m.

ravi: we should also add a short-term config change: reduce preproc thread_pool size from 16 -> 6 for any tokenizer container to avoid thread spin under pathological prompts. Putting PR up now.

emily: posting quick customer impact summary for support:
- window: 20:04 - 20:22 UTC
- approx 8-12% of requests affected for heavy embedding customers in EU
- mitigation: rate limiting + hotpatch rolled -> errors falling

sarah: handing off to jia for oncall next 30m while I go to sync with infra about node health. Jia, take action items: monitor for re-occurrence, validate no further OOMs, confirm rollback plan if hotpatch causes issues.

jia: taking handoff. Key next steps I'm tracking:
1) confirm no more OOMKills for 30m
2) watch 99p latency and 5xx rate for embeddings and chat routes
3) merge short-term PR to reduce thread pool and roll out cluster-wide if safe
4) schedule postmortem and assign owner (sarah + mike)

mike: noted. I'll do a deeper run through logs and build a test-case for the regex hotloop. Will include a failing prompt sample for the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident update (2143650300): All critical mitigations applied. 5xx now at 0.7% and 99p latency trending down. Recommend continued monitoring for 1h then update severity to P2.

jia: marking this as mitigated for now. We'll keep the envoy rate limits for 2 hours and then gradually relax. Postmortem owner: sarah + mike. Action items:
- temporary rate limits -> rollback plan (emily)
- unit test for tokenizer regex path (mike)
- infra: node health re-provision & ensure kernel oom tuning (ravi)
- add alert: sudden tokenflow spikes -> auto-scale preproc horizontally (jia)

sarah: thanks everyone. I'll prep the incident write-up once we have logs and the prompt sample. Will close the pager after 1h stable. :white_check_mark:
